Ref: Our letter bearing reference no. PNBHFL/SE/EQ/FY2026-27/73 dated September 15, 2026 
---------------------- 
 
With reference to the above, we wish to inform that Mr. Vinay Gupta, Chief Financial Officer and Mr. 
Chaitanya Yadav, National Head- Corporate Planning & Investor Relations of the Company had participated 
in One on One and Group Investor meeting (Physical) in the ‘J.P. Morgan India Conference’ in Mumbai 
today i.e. Monday, September 21, 2026. The details of Investors/participants are provided in the Annexure. 
 
The subject matter of discussions are on business strategy, margins, asset quality, return profile and future 
outlook of the Company which are covered in detail in the Investor Presentations, earnings call 
recordings/transcripts, press-release, etc. already submitted to the stock exchange(s). No unpublished price 
sensitive information was shared during the meeting. 
 
This intimation is submitted pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015.  
 
The above intimation is also made available on website of the Company https://www.pnbhousing.com/ 
 
Kindly take the above intimation on record. 
 
Thanking You, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For PNB Housing Finance Limited 
 
 
 
Veena G Kamath 
Company Secretary
